title: AgentTrust: a gateway that gets websites ready for AI agents
instructions: Voice: a confident, warm product-launch narrator. Pace: brisk and energetic but clear, like a polished startup demo video. Short natural pauses at full stops. Slight emphasis on the numbers and on the product name AgentTrust.

scenes.vo: Your website has new visitors: AI agents. They crawl, shop, and subscribe for people. But your site was built for humans.
scenes.caption: Your website has new visitors: *AI agents.* / They crawl, shop, and subscribe for people. / But your site was built for *humans.*

scenes.vo: Problem one: agents take, but don't pay. OpenAI crawls about 1,700 pages for every visitor it sends back. Anthropic: 73,000.
scenes.caption: Problem one: agents *take, but don't pay.* / OpenAI crawls about 1,700 pages for every visitor it sends back. Anthropic: *73,000.*

visual.title: Pages crawled for every visitor sent back

scenes.vo: Two: they don't have to follow your rules. Robots.txt is only a request. Bots probe admin pages and private data, and burst requests that load your servers.
scenes.caption: Two: they don't have to *follow your rules.* Robots.txt is only a *request.* / Bots probe admin pages and private data, and burst requests that load your servers.

items.sub: a polite request, not a rule

scenes.vo: Three: good agents can't pay you. Logins, CAPTCHAs, and checkout forms are built for people.
scenes.caption: Three: good agents *can't pay you.* / Logins, CAPTCHAs, and checkout forms are built for *people.*

scenes.vo: So today, you block every agent and lose the good ones, or let them all in, and get scraped.
scenes.caption: So today, you *block every agent* and lose the good ones, / or *let them all in,* and get scraped.

scenes.vo: AgentTrust is a third option: a gateway in front of your website, backed by PayPal.
scenes.caption: AgentTrust is a *third option:* / a *gateway* in front of your website, *backed by PayPal.*

scenes.vo: Every agent comes through it. It publishes your rules and prices, answers with a four-oh-two, takes a refundable PayPal deposit, checks every request, then refunds or keeps the deposit. Your site doesn't change.
scenes.caption: Every agent comes *through it.* It publishes your *rules and prices,* answers with a 402, / takes a *refundable PayPal deposit,* checks *every request,* / then refunds or keeps the deposit. Your site *doesn't change.*

visual.sub: sits in front of your site, on every request

scenes.vo: Honest agents get the deposit back, so following your rules costs them nothing. Rule-breakers are blocked on the spot, and lose it.
scenes.caption: Honest agents get the deposit back, so following your rules *costs them nothing.* / Rule-breakers are *blocked on the spot,* and lose it.
